name: audio_reactive
description: Light intensity follows the loudness of an audio input (pulse)

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Audio input device name, or a part of it (empty = system default)

parameters.name: min_intensity
parameters.description: Intensity when the input is silent [0.0 - 1.0]

parameters.name: sensitivity
parameters.description: Gain applied to the normalized level [0.1 - 5.0]

parameters.name: attack
parameters.description: Rise time in milliseconds (how fast the light reacts to a louder sound)

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Fall time in milliseconds (how slowly the light fades when the sound drops)
